name: Treasure Chest
desc: Pirate treasure chest with an arched lid breathing open over a golden hoard — glinting coins, pulsing glowing gems, a pearl necklace draped over the rim, rising star sparkles, iron bands and a hasp lock, and warm light spilling out. openA dials it from locked shut to fully open. Styles: classic wood, SUNKEN barnacle-teal (for seabed scenes), dark oak, cursed green-glow, candy toybox.
